name: ffalor-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugin marketplace. Holds plugins ffalor maintains, plus vetted copies of third-party plugins.

plugins.name: bouncer
plugins.description: Deny or annotate risky Edit/Write/Bash tool calls whose content matches markdown guardrail rules; forge new rules from complaints with the omfg skill.

plugins.name: session-insights
plugins.description: Mine session history for durable improvements: extract non-obvious learnings into AGENTS.md files, and analyze usage patterns to suggest new skills, plugins, and agents.

plugins.name: submit-review
plugins.description: Post code reviews with line-level comments to GitHub PRs via the gh CLI

plugins.name: terraform-framework-reference
plugins.description: Local, version-matched copy of the Terraform Plugin Framework and plugin-testing docs. Syncs the exact .mdx pages your provider's go.mod compiles against, so lookups are verbatim and offline.

plugins.name: track-implementation
plugins.description: Implement a spec while maintaining a running implementation-notes.html that records design decisions, deliberate deviations, tradeoffs, and open questions.
